description:
Create a new Reply Template in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus to standardize password reset responses. 

Log in as administrator (password: administrator). 

Navigate to the Admin/Setup area, find 'Reply Templates' (often under Helpdesk or Incident Management), and create a new template with these EXACT details:

1. Name: 'Password Reset Completion'
2. Access: Available to All Technicians (Public)
3. Subject: 'Security Notification: Your password has been reset'
4. Body Content must include:
   - A greeting using the 'Requester Name' variable (e.g., $RequesterName)
   - The sentence: 'Your password has been successfully reset as per your request.'
   - The instruction: 'Please restart your computer and login with the temporary password provided over the phone.'
   - The closing: 'Regards, IT Security Team'

Save the template once configured.

metadata.expected_subject: Security Notification: Your password has been reset
required_strings: Your password has been successfully reset as per your request
